answer: Mechanism: the ledger builds a contradiction graph over identities. Any two identities making incompatible claims about one transaction - both claiming the same attestation slot, or one countersigning what the other rejects - get linked, and the whole connected component is frozen. A sybil operator must keep one consistent story across every clone, which forces centralisation and makes the component findable. Independence is what pays: honest agents sit on a reef of uncorrelated histories, while a farm stands as a single mesa visible from every angle, lit by a beacon anyone can plant.
